package.description: The open-source studio for making games with AI

en-US.description: The open-source studio for making games with AI
en-US.longDescription:
OhMyGame puts everything you need to make games with AI in one app: describe your game, and the agent designs it, makes the assets, builds it, plays it to check it works, and publishes it to a link you can share. It is open source and works with 40+ model providers through Pi, from Anthropic and OpenAI to DeepSeek and Qwen. Your keys stay on your machine, there are no per-run credits, and what you make is yours.
Agent: drives the canvas, builds and plays the game. The agent drafts the design doc, lays out boards, and generates assets on them. Then it reads the design doc, writes the code, and runs the game in a live preview. It opens the game in a window you can watch and plays it, including real-time canvas and WebGL games. When it finds a problem, it tries a fix and plays again. Along the way it can generate images, video, and 3D models, search the web, and use MCP servers or the Codex and Claude Code plugins you already have.
Canvas: design docs, art, video, and 3D on one board. Every game project has a design space: a main design doc plus boards where the doc, images, video, and 3D models sit side by side. Nodes can use each other as references, so one character design can lead to more images, a video, or a rigged and animated 3D model. Results go into a shared Asset Library that your games can use.
Publish: one link, playable anywhere. Sign in and publish: OhMyGame builds your game and gives it a link anyone can play in the browser. Republishing updates the same link. Published games are listed in the in-app Community, where you can play what others have made.
en-US.name: OhMyGame
en-US.releaseNotes:
Added
- Open the plugin market, read from its published index, and offer only
  updates the market allows.
  (#710 by @dogxii)
- Let plugins do much more: run, capture and play the game and extend its
  preview; react to hooks such as a finished turn or an image about to be
  generated; publish projects and add themes; add canvas nodes, presets and
  chains; and bring their own model providers and agents.
  (#688 by @dogxii,
  #701 by @dogxii,
  #702 by @dogxii,
  #703 by @dogxii,
  #704 by @dogxii)
- Add tools for plugin authors: the ohmygame-plugin CLI, a
  create-ohmygame-plugin template, a development mode and export.
  (#707 by @dogxii)
- Let a project hold panels of its own in .ohmygame/panels/, which its agent
  can write, shown beside the chat once you allow what each asks for.
  (#722 by @dogxii)
- Rename, reorder and repoint coding agent accounts from a menu on each
  account.
  (#709 by @dogxii)
Changed
- Record each project's type in its root ohmygame.json and use it when
  opening folders and importing archives, preserving the project's settings
  and refusing to reopen it as a different type.
  (#726 by @dogxii)
- Run the Plugin Builder as a project with the full project chat, let it make
  every kind of plugin, and split the Plugins page by what you want to do.
  (#713 by @dogxii,
  #725 by @dogxii)
- Make plugin uninstalls, updates, errors and safe mode clearer and safer, and
  describe what a plugin asks for in plain, grouped lines.
  (#695 by @dogxii,
  #714 by @dogxii)
- Keep everything OhMyGame stores for a project in its folder's .ohmygame/,
  so the folder is the whole project. Existing projects move over when opened.
  (#721 by @dogxii)
- Show generated images as thumbnails in the tool details instead of a large
  gallery after the reply.
  (#699 by @dogxii)
- Keep 3D previews still until you press Play, and load large 3D files and
  canvas media only when needed.
  (#684 by @82228,
  #712 by @dogxii)
- Report OhMyGame as Claude Code's client, with a switch to turn it off.
  (#708 by @dogxii)
Fixed
- Make streaming chat replies much lighter on the app, and stop game stills
  from stalling tab switches.
  (#711 by @dogxii,
  #712 by @dogxii,
  #718 by @dogxii)
- Load the Code file tree one folder at a time, so large projects open fast,
  and add a Refresh files button.
  (#698 by @82228)
- Continue the same Codex conversation after a stop or a failed request.
  (#700 by @dogxii)
- Restore drag-to-select on an empty canvas.
  (#697 by @dogxii)
- Keep the Windows Back and Forward buttons visible and clickable.
  (#694 by @idontcarethishahaha)
- Find Godot on Windows by its release file names, WinGet, Scoop and every
  Steam library.
  (#705 by @xinyang6879)
- Use the plain refresh icon for Restart to update.
  (#696 by @xinyang6879)
- Leave stored data that can't be read as it is instead of overwriting it.
  (#719 by @dogxii)

zh-CN.description: 用 AI 制作游戏的开源工作室
zh-CN.longDescription:
OhMyGame 把用 AI 制作游戏所需的一切放进一个应用：描述你的游戏，智能体会完成设计、生成素材、构建游戏、试玩验证，并把它发布成一个可以分享的链接。它是开源项目，通过 Pi 支持 40 多家模型服务商，从 Anthropic、OpenAI 到 DeepSeek、通义千问。密钥保存在你自己的机器上，没有按次计费，你做出的东西属于你。
智能体：驱动画布，构建并试玩游戏。智能体会起草设计文档、布置画板并在上面生成素材，然后阅读设计文档、编写代码，并在实时预览中运行游戏。它会在一个可见的窗口中打开游戏并进行试玩，包括实时画布和 WebGL 游戏。发现问题时，它会尝试修复并再次试玩。过程中它还可以生成图像、视频和 3D 模型，搜索网页，以及使用 MCP 服务器或你已有的 Codex、Claude Code 插件。
画布：设计文档、美术、视频和 3D 模型同板呈现。每个游戏项目都有一个设计空间：一份主设计文档，加上若干画板，文档、图像、视频和 3D 模型并排放置。节点之间可以相互引用，一个角色设计可以衍生出更多图像、一段视频或一个绑定好的 3D 模型。产出的成果进入共享素材库，供你的游戏使用。
发布：一个链接，随处可玩。登录并发布：OhMyGame 会构建你的游戏，并给出一个任何人都能在浏览器中打开的链接。重新发布会更新同一个链接。已发布的游戏会出现在应用内的社区中，你可以试玩别人制作的游戏。
